question: Should this plugin boundary be enforced as a true security boundary before plugin execution, or narrowed to an advisory/compatibility check until runtime resolution enforcement and upgrade rollout are ready?
rationale: The code direction affects plugin compatibility and the repository's security-boundary claim; automation should not choose the permanent enforcement model or rollout policy for maintainers.

options.title: Redesign before merge
options.body: Replace the static regex gate with resolver-backed enforcement or AST plus recursive resolution, then add compatibility proof for existing and bundled plugins.

options.title: Ship as advisory only
options.body: Keep the scan fail-open or diagnostic-only so it does not claim a security boundary or break existing plugins while the stronger design is developed.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Close or pause this branch until a narrower plugin-loader security design and migration plan is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Redesign before merge
recommendation.body: Replace the static regex gate with resolver-backed enforcement or AST plus recursive resolution, then add compatibility proof for existing and bundled plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author is also listed for Security and has the most direct recent history on this boundary.
